flags.all_identity_support: all fixed 15 identities have both-day raw support
flags.claim_flags: any/all ORIGINAL enrollment trial support plus original probe support; diagnostics, no partial-failure policy
flags.complete_historical_trial_support: every original historical eligible day1/day2 trial has units
flags.complete_segment_interpretation: raw support only; one sample is not a trainable feature; conceptual unit counts may be below two despite ample samples
flags.identity_support: at least one day1 enrollment trial and one day2 probe trial with units
flags.some_identity_support: any of the fixed 15 identities has both-day raw support
flags.train_gate: at least two units per identity, both days combined, for each frozen 9/12 TRAIN owner
flags.train_gate_interpretation: conservative proposed WCCN count gate only; no covariance or extraction feasibility proof

plan.graph_projection: frozen registration.plan.folds and development.coverage; validate using source_coverage historical256-positive trials and the documented ordered crossfit projection
plan.no_expansion: same all-15 cohort and 20 outer folds; source-present old-graph-absent trials stay separate; no protocol choice or promotion
